summary: Cyble wins three Top InfoSec Innovators Awards 2026 for AI-driven threat intelligence, cyber asset attack surface management, and digital risk protection.

# Triple Win! Cyble Sweeps the Top InfoSec Innovators Awards 2026


**Cyble’s innovation in AI-driven threat intelligence, cyber asset attack surface management, and digital risk protection gets recognized.**


**Cupertino, California – October 22, 2026** – Cyble, a global AI-native cybersecurity company, has been named a winner in three prestigious categories at the Top InfoSec Innovators 2026 Awards, recognizing its innovation across critical areas of cybersecurity.


Cyble secured wins in the categories of:


- **Most Innovative AI-Driven Threat Intelligence and Response**
- **Best Solution in Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM)**
- **Cutting Edge Digital Risk Protection (DRP)** .


The three awards recognize Cyble’s work in addressing complex cybersecurity challenges and advancing capabilities that help organizations gain visibility into threats, understand their digital exposure, and strengthen their defenses against evolving risks.


“Today’s cyber threats demand more than traditional security approaches. Organizations need intelligence that enables them to understand their exposure, anticipate emerging risks, and make faster, better-informed security decisions. Winning across three categories at the Top InfoSec Innovators 2026 Awards reinforces our commitment to advancing AI-native cybersecurity and delivering capabilities that address real-world security challenges,” said **Beenu Arora, CEO and Co-founder of Cyble** . “We will continue to push the boundaries of innovation across threat intelligence,[attack surface management](https://cyble.com/solutions/attack-surface-management/) , and digital risk protection to help organizations build stronger, more proactive cyber defenses.”


As organizations expand their digital infrastructure and adopt new technologies, their exposure to cyber threats continues to grow across external assets, digital platforms, and interconnected environments. Security teams must navigate an expanding volume of threat intelligence while identifying the risks that require immediate attention. Cyble’s AI-native approach focuses on connecting[threat intelligence](https://cyble.com/solutions/cyber-threat-intelligence/) with actionable security insights, helping organizations improve visibility, prioritize risks, and make informed decisions in an increasingly dynamic threat landscape.


The recognition across three distinct categories reflects the breadth of Cyble’s capabilities and its continued focus on developing solutions for the evolving needs of enterprises and government organizations. By advancing AI-driven threat intelligence and strengthening capabilities in CAASM and DRP, Cyble aims to help security teams move beyond reactive responses toward a more intelligence-led and proactive approach to cybersecurity.


These wins further reinforce Cyble’s commitment to cybersecurity innovation, with continued investment in AI-native technologies, threat research, and actionable intelligence to help organizations better understand their risk landscape and strengthen their cyber resilience.


**About Cyble**


Cyble is a global AI-native cybersecurity company helping organizations and governments identify, assess, and respond to evolving cyber threats. Its portfolio includes AI-driven threat intelligence, digital risk protection, cyber asset attack surface management, and other cybersecurity solutions designed to improve threat visibility and enable proactive risk management. Through its technology and threat research capabilities, Cyble empowers security teams with actionable insights to make informed decisions and strengthen their cybersecurity posture.
